characters.name: 秋娘
characters.design: 48-year-old female innkeeper, wearing indigo cloth and dark apron, wooden hairpin in bun, fine lines at eye corners, bending to wipe rough porcelain bowls with hands in motion, realistic wuxia style, warm side lighting on face to show rustic simplicity, half-body environmental portrait perspective

characters.name: 秦无边
characters.design: 60-year-old male retired escort, wearing worn dark grey robe, long grey-white beard, rusty-sheathed long knife at waist, thick knuckles, sitting on wooden bench holding wine bowl with melancholy expression, realistic style, oil lamp warm light on side face, loess wall in background, three-quarter body environmental portrait perspective

props.name: 锈鞘长刀
props.design: Old wooden scabbard covered in reddish-brown rust, handle wrapped in worn black leather, length up to waist, slightly tilted when placed on wooden table, realistic texture with natural wear marks, cold moonlight can reflect rust spots, desktop eye-level close-up perspective

props.name: 粗瓷酒坛
props.design: Coarse pottery dark brown wine jar, with fine kiln crackle on body, sealed with light yellow hemp rope knot, slight steam coming out when holding warmed wine, rustic realistic texture, clay texture visible under warm light, medium shot with hand placing the jar

props.name: 老旧油灯
props.design: Old pottery oil lamp, burning pale yellow flame at wick, oil stains from use on lamp body, placed at edge of wooden table as main warm indoor light source, realistic style with clear details in dark areas, medium shot with soft halo effect

scenes.name: 大漠客栈内景
scenes.design: Night interior of frontier desert inn, loess rammed earth walls with weathering cracks, rammed earth floor, illuminated only by warm oil lamp light, wooden tables and benches in corner, low saturation warm tone, rustic ancient feel, panoramic shot with door frame composition

scenes.name: 客栈外沙丘夜
scenes.design: Night desert dune scene outside frontier inn, soft undulating dune contours, silver moonlight sprinkled on sand surface, faint camel silhouettes in distance, wind blowing fine sand with subtle motion blur, low saturation cool tone, desolate atmosphere, long shot with inn door frame as foreground
